cx.name: Scheduled tasks / Automations
cx.purpose: Revisit assigned work on a saved schedule
cx.cn: 按照已設定的時間回來做事
cx.story: You schedule a weekday 09:00 review of a local project. When the app starts the task, your colleague reads project files and prepares a short progress brief. For local-project tasks, the app must be running and the computer awake; the schedule does not turn on your laptop.
cx.storycn: 你在 App 排好每個上班日 09:00 查看本機專案。任務啟動後，同事用檔案工具讀專案資料，整理進度摘要；這類本機工作需要 App 開著、電腦醒著，排程不會替你開機。
cx.detail: Standalone tasks start fresh chats; in-chat schedules reuse context. Local projects require the app running and the machine awake.
cx.bound: Product documentation only for the scheduler. CLI has no Scheduled management interface. The former Codex documentation URL now redirects to shared ChatGPT documentation.
cx.example_setup: App schedule + local project files / App 排程＋本機專案檔案

cx.name: /goal
cx.purpose: Continue an assigned objective after a turn ends
cx.cn: 一輪做完但目標未完成，就接著做
cx.story: You give your colleague the goal of making the tests pass. They edit files and run tests; when the turn ends and the goal remains active, the runtime can start another turn within its controls. They continue the assigned repair rather than waiting for another “continue” message.
cx.storycn: 你給同事的目標是「讓測試通過」。他用編輯工具改檔、用命令列跑測試；回合結束但目標仍有效時，runtime 可在控制條件內再開下一輪，繼續這份修復工作。
steps: Start next turn if still idle
cx.detail: on_thread_idle calls continue_if_idle. Runtime checks live thread, deferral and active status before start_turn_if_idle; accounting and stop handling are separate code paths.
cx.bound: Goal continuation is code-traced. It continues an existing objective; it does not independently select an external monitoring mission.
cx.example_setup: Goal controls + file editor + test command / 目標控制＋檔案編輯＋測試命令

cx.name: codex exec / App Server
cx.purpose: Let your event handler start agent work
cx.cn: 由你接好的事件處理程式啟動工作
cx.story: Your build system reports a failed deployment. A listener you built receives the event and starts Codex through exec or App Server. The colleague then uses shell and file tools to inspect the logs and prepare a fix; Codex itself is not the build-event listener.
cx.storycn: 建置系統回報部署失敗，你自己接的監聽程式收到事件，再透過 exec 或 App Server 啟動 Codex。同事才用命令列與檔案工具讀紀錄、準備修正；建置事件的監聽要由整合程式負責。
cx.detail: The noninteractive entry constructs TurnStartParams and submits ClientRequest::TurnStart. Event subscription, deduplication and downstream event publication belong to the caller.
cx.bound: Native execution interface plus custom event wiring. Do not label it a built-in general webhook watcher.
cx.example_setup: Custom build listener + exec/App Server + shell / 自訂建置監聽＋exec/App Server＋命令列工具

cx.name: notify · legacy AfterAgent hook
cx.purpose: Run a configured command when a turn finishes
cx.cn: 工作回合結束後，呼叫已設定的通知程式
cx.story: Your colleague finishes checking a build. The turn-completion notification calls your configured script, which displays a desktop notice saying the result is ready. The script delivers the notice; it does not start another investigation.
cx.storycn: 同事完成建置檢查後，回合結束通知會呼叫你設定的腳本。腳本跳出桌面提醒：「結果好了，可以查看。」這是在送通知，不是再啟動同事查一次。
cx.detail: Legacy notify serializes agent-turn-complete data and starts the configured command. It does not wait for confirmed downstream delivery.
cx.bound: Completion notification is not environment observation or a model judgment of importance. The source marks this interface legacy.
cx.example_setup: Configured notify script + desktop notification / 已設定的 notify 腳本＋桌面通知

cc.name: /loop / CronCreate
cc.purpose: Check again during an open session
cc.cn: 在開著的工作對話中，過一陣子再查看
cc.story: While a deployment runs, you ask /loop to check every five minutes. Each check uses the deployment-status command and reports when the deployment is ready. This is a session schedule: the colleague is not independently watching after the session is gone.
cc.storycn: 部署還在跑，你用 /loop 交代每五分鐘看一次。每次啟動，同事就用部署狀態命令查進度，完成後回報；這是對話內排程，對話結束後不會自己在外面繼續盯。
cc.detail: Fixed schedules enqueue prompts between turns. Dynamic loops can choose pacing; recurring session tasks expire after seven days. Unexpired schedules can be restored on resume.
cc.bound: Scheduler internals are documented, not source-audited here. Bare /loop has a bounded maintenance prompt, not unrestricted goal invention.

cc.name: Monitor
cc.purpose: Receive changes from a background script
cc.cn: 讓背景程式把新狀況帶回來
cc.story: Your colleague starts a long-running log watcher through Monitor. When the watcher outputs a new error, that output returns to the session and prompts investigation. The colleague can then use shell tools to inspect the surrounding logs.
cc.storycn: 同事透過 Monitor 啟動一支持續看紀錄的程式。程式輸出新錯誤時，消息回到對話，才促使他查原因；接著他可用命令列工具讀錯誤前後的紀錄。
cc.detail: Where available, Monitor can back a dynamic loop by streaming script output. The monitoring script defines what is observed.
cc.bound: Availability is session-dependent. Background monitor processes are not restored on resume. Internal implementation not inspected.
cc.example_setup: Monitor + log-watching process + shell / Monitor＋紀錄監看程式＋命令列工具

cc.name: Channels
cc.purpose: Push outside events into a running session
cc.cn: 讓外部新消息進入正在執行的對話
cc.story: A teammate sends a message to the connected Telegram bot: “The latest build failed.” The channel delivers it into your colleague’s session. With repository and shell tools available, the colleague checks the problem and can reply through the Telegram channel.
cc.storycn: 同事在已連接的 Telegram bot 留言：「最新建置失敗了。」Channel 把訊息送進數位同事的對話；若已提供程式庫與命令列工具，他就查問題，並可透過 Telegram 回覆。
cc.detail: Official Telegram plugin emits a channel notification with content and routing metadata. Its reply tool calls Telegram sendMessage.
cc.bound: Plugin sender and reply code are public; Claude Code host ingestion remains documentation evidence. A custom CI or Outlook watcher still needs its own event adapter.
cc.example_setup: Telegram channel + repository/shell tools / Telegram 頻道＋程式庫與命令列工具

cc.name: Desktop scheduled tasks
cc.purpose: Start a local work session on schedule
cc.cn: 到時間就開一個本機工作回合
cc.story: You schedule a morning review of your project folder in Desktop. At the scheduled time, your colleague reads the local files and prepares a brief of changes and open issues. The desktop app and computer must be available for this local work.
cc.storycn: 你在 Desktop 排好每天早上整理專案資料夾。時間到了，同事就讀本機檔案，列出最新變更與未解問題；這份本機工作需要桌面 App 與電腦可用。
cc.detail: Local recurring tasks require an awake computer and open app. A running task can update its schedule through update_scheduled_task.
cc.bound: Official product contract; desktop scheduler source not inspected. It is independent of an open CLI conversation.
cc.example_setup: Desktop scheduled task + local file tools / Desktop 排程工作＋本機檔案工具

cc.name: Routines
cc.purpose: Start cloud work on time or an incoming trigger
cc.cn: 時間到了或收到指定事件，就在雲端開始做事
cc.story: You configure a cloud routine to review new pull requests. A PR is opened after you close your laptop; the configured trigger starts the cloud run, which reads the repository changes and records review findings. The work runs in the cloud environment you set up.
cc.storycn: 你先設定「有新 PR 就審查」的雲端 routine。關了筆電之後有人開 PR，已接好的觸發就啟動雲端工作，讀取程式庫變更並留下審查結果；工作在事先設定的雲端環境執行。
cc.detail: Routines accept schedules, API triggers and supported GitHub events. Each event starts an independent session with configured repositories and connectors.
cc.bound: Official product contract; cloud scheduler source unavailable in this audit. Review-preview limits and account configuration apply.
cc.example_setup: Configured PR trigger + cloud repository access / 已設定的 PR 觸發＋雲端程式庫存取

cc.name: Hooks
cc.purpose: React to an agent lifecycle event
cc.cn: 在工具執行或工作結束時，執行既定處理
cc.story: Your colleague edits a file, and an edit hook runs your configured check. If your Stop hook finds unfinished work when the colleague tries to finish, it can require follow-up. The check script supplies the condition; the colleague then uses editing and test tools to address it.
cc.storycn: 同事改完檔案，編輯後的 hook 就跑你指定的檢查。若他準備結束時，Stop hook 查到還有未完成事項，就可要求接著處理，再用編輯與測試工具補完；判斷條件由你的檢查腳本提供。
cc.detail: Hooks support deterministic handlers and selected prompt/agent checks. Stop hooks can block stopping; HTTP hooks call an endpoint.
cc.bound: Lifecycle hooks are not an incoming environment webhook subscription. Core implementation is not source-audited here.
cc.example_setup: Edit/Stop hooks + check script + editor / 編輯與 Stop hooks＋檢查腳本＋編輯工具

limits: Static source review and current official documentation, not deployed runtime tests.
